rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for looking around physically without a specific target.

example.english: I’ll browse around the mall and only buy something I like.
example.traditional: 我去商場周圍睇吓，睇啱先買。
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 soeng1 coeng4 zau1 wai4 tai2 haa5 tai2 ngaam1 sin1 maai5

rows.note: Use this when browsing websites or online content in everyday speech.

example.english: I browse online when I have free time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dak1 haan4 zau6 soeng5 mong5 tai2 je5

rows.jyutping: zau1 wai4 si3 sik6 si3 jam2
rows.note: Use this for moving around and sampling food or drinks on offer.

example.english: We browse around the market, sampling lots of food and drinks.
example.traditional: 個市集有好多試食試飲，我哋周圍試食試飲。
example.jyutping: go3 si5 zaap6 jau5 hou2 do1 si3 sik6 si3 jam2 ngo5 dei6 zau1 wai4 si3 sik6 si3 jam2

rows.note: Use this for moving around and trying displayed products or equipment.

example.english: You can browse around the electronics fair and try out the products.
example.traditional: 電器展入面可以周圍試用。
example.jyutping: din6 hei3 zin2 jap6 min6 ho2 ji5 zau1 wai4 si3 jung6
